blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — When rain falls over Sitio Lower Tambisan, 71-year-old Restituto Abella takes a seat outside his home and watches the water, then calls his grandchild Raendell to move their belongings to the second floor in case the flood rises higher this time. “Magbantay ra man ko diri. If makakita nako sa tubig, manawag nako sa akong apo (I just keep watch here. If I see the water [rise], I’ll call out to my grandchild),” said Abella, who has lived in the sitio in Barangay Tisa since 1990. Floodwater now enters his home almost daily, a pattern he did […]...
